project_name: Aditya Gaur, Advocate - Premium Legal Practice Website

art_direction.vibe: Elegantly minimal, authoritative, deeply trustworthy, sophisticated Indian legal advocate practice with bespoke typography and generous architectural whitespace.
art_direction.theme: Light theme dominant (70% Warm Ivory #F8F6F1 & Pure White #FFFFFF, 25% Deep Navy #0B1F33 & Secondary Navy #163A59, 5% Muted Gold #B89B5E).
anti_patterns: NO cheap templates or aggressive advertising popups
NO excessive gold or shiny gradients
NO generic scales of justice or wooden gavels placed everywhere
NO fake awards, fake star ratings, or guaranteed-result legal claims
NO dark mode default for public legal marketing pages
NO Inter for main or section headings (use Cormorant Garamond / Playfair Display)

color_palette.distribution_ratio: 70% Warm Ivory/White base, 25% Navy structural contrast, 5% Muted Gold accent

typography.accent_mono_font: JetBrains Mono, monospace (for court case numbers, chamber metadata, tags)

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-normal leading-[1.1] tracking-tight
scale.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-normal leading-snug tracking-tight
scale.body_large: text-lg sm:text-xl font-sans font-light leading-relaxed text-charcoal
scale.caption_overline: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-muted_gold font-semibold

layout_and_spacing.spacing_philosophy: Generous luxury spacing (2x to 3x standard). Use py-20 lg:py-32 for main sections and p-8 lg:p-12 for primary card containers.
layout_and_spacing.header_spec: Fixed top bar with glassmorphism backdrop-blur-md bg-[#F8F6F1]/90 border-b border-[#0B1F33]/10 z-50 h-20

grid_modes.practice_areas_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 lg:gap-8
grid_modes.jurisdiction_strip: flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 py-6 border-y border-[#B89B5E]/30

motion_specification.hero_reveal: Signature line-by-line masked text slide-up with subtle staggered gold accent line grow
motion_specification.scroll_behavior: Lenis momentum scroll for buttery editorial weight
motion_specification.editorial_marquee: Slow drifting text strip (gap-24, text-xs mono, uppercase, tracking-[0.3em], muted gold/navy palette)

hover_micro_interactions.card_lift: hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 ease-out border-l-2 border-transparent hover:border-[#B89B5E]

component_styling.primary_button: px-7 py-3.5 bg-[#0B1F33] text-[#F8F6F1] font-sans font-medium text-sm tracking-wider uppercase rounded-none hover:bg-[#163A59] transition-all duration-300 shadow-md border border-[#0B1F33] data-[testid]
component_styling.secondary_button: px-7 py-3.5 bg-transparent text-[#0B1F33] font-sans font-medium text-sm tracking-wider uppercase rounded-none hover:bg-[#0B1F33] hover:text-[#F8F6F1] transition-all duration-300 border border-[#0B1F33] data-[testid]
component_styling.gold_accent_button: px-7 py-3.5 bg-[#B89B5E] text-[#0B1F33] font-sans font-semibold text-sm tracking-wider uppercase rounded-none hover:bg-[#A28549] hover:text-white transition-all duration-300 shadow-sm data-[testid]
component_styling.card: bg-[#FCFBF8] border border-[#0B1F33]/10 p-8 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300
component_styling.accordion: border-b border-[#0B1F33]/10 py-5 text-left font-serif text-lg text-[#0B1F33]
component_styling.breadcrumbs: text-xs font-mono tracking-wider text-charcoal/60 uppercase flex items-center gap-2

page_structures.homepage: Hero (Masked Heading + Portrait + Trust Strip) -> Chamber & Identity Intro -> Practice Areas Bento -> High Court & Supreme Court Practice Strip -> Local Jurisdictions (Faridabad, Delhi, Noida, Gurugram) -> Case Process / Client Approach -> Legal Insights Preview -> Contact & Chamber Address -> Footer
page_structures.practice_area_detail: Breadcrumb -> H1 Practice Title & Key Takeaways -> Practice Scope & Statutory Provisions -> Common Scenarios -> Case Approach & Procedure -> FAQ Accordion -> Consultation CTA Form -> Related Practice Areas
page_structures.location_seo_page: Breadcrumb -> H1 Jurisdiction Title (e.g., 'Advocate in Faridabad | District Courts Sector 12') -> Chamber Presence & Regional Expertise -> Courts Covered in Zone -> Key Practice Areas Handled -> Local Process & FAQs -> Direct Contact CTA
page_structures.admin_dashboard: Clean minimalist tabular interface in Deep Navy & White with status badges (New, Contacted, In Progress, Archived), filterable enquiries list, and article draft manager.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rule: Every button, link, form field, tab, modal trigger, and filter MUST have an explicit data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='hero-book-consultation-btn').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast_wcag: Text contrast strictly exceeds WCAG AA (Navy #0B1F33 on Warm Ivory #F8F6F1 ratio is ~14.8:1). Muted Gold is used for background fills with dark text or as borders/accents, never for small text on white.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling on top of React.
Ensure all 18 practice area pages and location SEO pages have distinct content, breadcrumbs, H1s, FAQs, and data-testid attributes.
Create a clean, functional Admin Dashboard at /admin with simulated auth or token state for enquiry management and blog creation.
Do NOT use markdown wrapping when generating or referencing this json file.
